calculation.description: Compute each asset's three-day return residual to the cross-asset median, reverse it, normalize by trailing 20-day return volatility, and activate it only when mean absolute cross-sectional daily-return dispersion is above its trailing 60-day median. Cross-sectional median is removed again from the resulting signal for portfolio ranking.

validation.regime_notes: Daily one-day forward-return admission horizon. Regime IC/ICIR: 2020 0.052399/0.140804; 2023 0.045401/0.128752; 2025 0.078325/0.226603; 2026-07 onward 0.043499/0.150030. Five-day decay remains positive but below the daily ICIR gate. Validation uses all 15 tradable benchmark instruments and at least 8 valid names per date; sparse activation lowers unconditional signal coverage, so uncertainty is interpreted conservatively.
